title: Impulse Space header
description: A fixed, see-through header drawn in white with a difference blend, so it inverts over whatever scrolls under it (copper over a blue sky, black over white). Desktop: one centred cluster, a tracked-capital wordmark then uppercase mono links at 50% that brighten on hover in 0.25s, and a chevron that opens a small menu. Phones: wordmark left, a two-line burger right that opens a full-screen black menu.
notes: fixed and out of the flow: the page's first section runs under it
no JavaScript: both menus are <details> elements
the bar uses the .dark scope's foreground (white) for the difference blend, so it reads on any theme
name: impulsespace-header
